name: Chalkboard Maths
tagline: Dim and reveal, one claim at a time. The 3Blue1Brown lesson feel.

motion.direction: A lesson on a chalkboard. Dim-and-reveal: one claim or `equation` on the board at a time, drawn in as it is spoken, fading when the next arrives. `chapterCard` per step of the argument (yellow chalk number), `counter`s for quantities, `strikeLine` through the wrong intuition. Chalk colours: `iv` white for statements, `gold` yellow for the key term, `goldd` blue for definitions, `ter` pink for warnings. Longer holds (3–4 s), still camera, `card` mode for most of the reel so the board shows. No slams, no stamps, no punch-ins.
